description: Official Piko 3.11.1 bundle by crimera (GPL-3.0), mirrored as a personal Morphe source. 140 patches total: 75 for X (Twitter) targeting X 12.19.1-release.0 (com.twitter.android, APKM bundle) and 66 for Instagram. Needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not an X APK.
